hero.headline: Gym Attendance, Now Smarter & More Efficient
hero.sub: Manage member check-ins, membership packages, and reports — all in one digital platform.

pain.title: Still doing it the old way?

items.title: Manual attendance
items.desc: Attendance books get lost, are hard to search, and are prone to writing errors.

items.title: No expiry control
items.desc: Members who haven't paid can still enter without being detected.

items.title: Multi-location is messy
items.desc: Managing multiple gym branches at once without integrated data.

items.title: QR Scan & Camera
items.desc: Automatic check-in via smartphone camera or printed QR scan.

items.title: Flexible Membership Packages
items.desc: Create packages with custom durations and prices to fit your gym's needs.

items.title: Multi-Role Staff
items.desc: Admin, staff, and member — each with the right level of access.

items.title: Real-time Dashboard
items.desc: Monitor live attendance, daily reports, and member statistics anytime.

items.title: Multi-Tenant
items.desc: One platform for many gym branches — data 100% isolated.

items.title: No Special Hardware
items.desc: Just a regular smartphone or laptop — no need to buy expensive equipment.

variants.title: Flexible for any gym setup
variants.sub: Choose the approach that best fits your gym environment

slides.title: Mobile + Printed QR
slides.desc: Print a QR code, stick it on the wall, and members just scan it with their own camera. No additional devices needed.

slides.title: Tablet as Kiosk
slides.desc: Place a tablet at the reception desk. The tablet camera automatically detects members' QR codes as they arrive.

slides.title: PC / Laptop + Webcam
slides.desc: Use the computer already at the front desk. A standard webcam is enough to auto-scan members' QR codes.

adminPreview.title: Full control in your hands
adminPreview.sub: Complete admin dashboard — monitor attendance, manage members, set packages, all from one screen.

memberPreview.title: A seamless member experience
memberPreview.sub: Members can check membership status, attendance history, level up through XP, and unlock rewards — all from one app.

cta.title: Ready to upgrade your gym management?
cta.sub: Start now — free consultation, quick setup.

demo.modalSub: 30-minute session · no signup · data resets hourly
